folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B401: social, place, conflict and authoring checkpoint substance
folds.body:
The complete P18–P28 checkpoints were read, including late corrections and collision history. Preserve QA's actual seven P3 deck declarations rather than eight; those were counted, not executed. A manifest of dirty source bytes is stronger than HEAD alone. Syntax-valid JSON, a source range inside a file, a proposal marker, a fixed table count or a mechanical text exclusion does not prove semantic fit, gameplay, source authentication, fairness or exhaustive secrecy. These checkpoints do not refresh the linked report/source evidence.

P19/P20 retain useful distinct actors and scopes: personal motives/means, actual gossip channels, lineage, local place/estate change, dated news, social recognition and material residue. P21 already found its older courtyard/investing/shipping absence claims superseded. A guarded attempt is not a proven rescue; transient battle detail, relationship windows, event feed and life-record text cannot supply durable callback authority after eviction. Real consequential outcomes and supply/history need their actual owners. Source-observed paths and an old hash refresh are not a current rebuilt journey.

P22/P25 developer/director/export proposals remain separate from normal character control and actual durable world truth. A basic path/disclosure-marker check was not the proposed export scanner. Markdown/ASCII workspace sketches were not rendered UI. P23's inner-life and moral/ambition examples do not create a universal morality score or authenticate unknown source laws. Missing source bodies and secondary book/wiki references retain their limits. P24's foreknowledge, reports, item histories and time structures need their actual observer, carrier, support and clock; a record of the past is not an omniscient present or guaranteed future.

P26's 89 templates, genres, jokes and firsts preserve committed semantic outcomes before expression. Its corrected comparison and volume windows are not new primary reading here. P27's travel, groups, teaching and death options remain separately selectable without requiring a universal death/afterlife engine. Collision repairs preserved the story P26/P27 documents rather than using accidental crafting assignments as authority. P28's appended crafting assignment remains mixed history; the matching delivered crafting-play/automation/collection/director work is routed to CR3 by current PLAN and that lane's checkpoint/report. It is not unfinished story work or permission to overwrite shared names.

Current UI targets, explicit compatibility, AD36/AD42/AD51/AD52 and lead-first priorities qualify all older viewport, full-suite, human-gate, source-priority and procedural-layout statements. NPC-heavy and testbed-depth proposals do not become the next wave. Useful ideas, exact source conflicts, original IDs and history remain; no new story authority, runtime model call, user-profile/taste collection, current source fact, native export, gameplay, migration or creative-director tool was implemented.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B401: current routing for the mixed assignment history
folds.body: The entire checkpoint, including the separate appended crafting assignment, was read. Keep the earlier story intent/taste/writers-room/onboarding result and collision history intact. The actual PLAN CR3 row and delivered cr3/CHECKPOINT.md plus its REPORT opening route PLAY_FEEL, AUTOMATION, COLLECTION and DIRECTOR_TOOLS to CR3. The late crafting tail here therefore remains historical assignment residue, not an active next-writing instruction for p28. Do not recreate those artifacts or overwrite this story lane's MORE/REPORT. CR3's source-only inspection and proposed native gates remain its own evidence; matching filenames do not certify all corresponding mechanics. Present writer/process scope must be recovered if a new slice is selected. No implementation or delegation is selected by this routing correction.
